Head: Still.dancer: 我低下頭，向所有看不見的長輩致敬
Head: Still.spirit_zh: 我看見你的臣服。皇冠已放在你頭上了，孩子。
Head: Still.spirit_en: I see your reverence. The crown is now upon you, child.

Head: Sway.dancer: 我的頭隨風輕搖，尋找遺失的星路
Head: Sway.spirit_zh: 風知道你要找什麼。我已把星路放回你的髮絲之間。
Head: Sway.spirit_en: The wind knows what you seek. I have placed the star path back in your hair.

Head: Stamp.dancer: 我用頭顱觸地，喚醒沉睡千年的記憶
Head: Stamp.spirit_zh: 我醒了。所有沉睡的長老都睜開了眼，看著你。
Head: Stamp.spirit_en: We are awake. Every elder who slept for a thousand years is watching you.

Head: Fling.dancer: 我甩動長髮，向天空挑戰
Head: Fling.spirit_zh: 雷電聽見了你的挑釁。它說：歡迎回來，戰士。
Head: Fling.spirit_en: Thunder heard your challenge. It says: Welcome back, warrior.

Head: Circle.spirit_zh: 圓已成形。時間從此以你為起點。
Head: Circle.spirit_en: The circle is complete. Time now begins with you.

Head: Sacrifice.dancer: 我獻出我的意識，讓祖靈進入
Head: Sacrifice.spirit_zh: 我已經進來了。從今以後，你的夢境屬於我們所有人。
Head: Sacrifice.spirit_en: I have entered. From now on, your dreams belong to all of us.

Left Arm: Still.dancer: 我左手靜止，握住十代的哀傷
Left Arm: Still.spirit_zh: 我幫你握著。你不會再一個人承擔。
Left Arm: Still.spirit_en: I hold it with you. You are no longer alone.

Left Arm: Sway.dancer: 我左臂如江河，流向歸處
Left Arm: Sway.spirit_zh: 河已知道歸途。我在海口等你。
Left Arm: Sway.spirit_en: The river knows its way home. I wait at the sea.

Left Arm: Stamp.dancer: 我左拳擊空，為正義而怒
Left Arm: Stamp.spirit_zh: 怒火我收到了。它已點燃守護之火。
Left Arm: Stamp.spirit_en: I received your rage. The protective fire is now lit.

Left Arm: Fling.dancer: 我把所有悲傷與穢氣甩向夜空
Left Arm: Fling.spirit_zh: 我全接住了。它們現在變成流星，為你指引歸鄉的路。
Left Arm: Fling.spirit_en: I caught everything. They are now shooting stars guiding you home.

Left Arm: Circle.dancer: 我用左臂為大家織出保護圈
Left Arm: Circle.spirit_zh: 護盾已成。從今以後，沒有人能傷害這個圓圈。
Left Arm: Circle.spirit_en: The shield is woven. No harm can enter this circle again.

Left Arm: Sacrifice.dancer: 我張開左掌，獻出我的未來
Left Arm: Sacrifice.spirit_zh: 我收下了。你的未來現在屬於部落。
Left Arm: Sacrifice.spirit_en: I accept. Your future now belongs to the tribe.

Right Arm: Still.dancer: 我右手凝止，守護最後的聖秘
Right Arm: Still.spirit_zh: 秘密很安全。我和你一起守。
Right Arm: Still.spirit_en: The secret is safe. I guard it with you.

Right Arm: Sway.dancer: 我右臂與看不見的舞伴共舞
Right Arm: Sway.spirit_zh: 我就是你的舞伴。終於等到你回來了。
Right Arm: Sway.spirit_en: I am your invisible partner. I have waited so long for this dance.

Right Arm: Stamp.dancer: 我右拳擊胸，這是部落的心跳
Right Arm: Stamp.spirit_zh: 我聽見了。整個山都在跟著你跳。
Right Arm: Stamp.spirit_en: I heard it. The entire mountain beats with you.

Right Arm: Fling.dancer: 我將祝福猛力甩向天空
Right Arm: Fling.spirit_zh: 祝福我接住了。它們已長出翅膀，正在回來找你。
Right Arm: Fling.spirit_en: I caught your blessings. They have grown wings and are returning to you.

Right Arm: Circle.dancer: 我用右臂把太陽拉回聖圈
Right Arm: Circle.spirit_zh: 太陽回來了。它說：謝謝你記得我。現在我把光還給你。
Right Arm: Circle.spirit_en: The sun has returned. It says: Thank you for remembering me. Here is your light back.

Right Arm: Sacrifice.dancer: 我右手抵額，臣服即勝利
Right Arm: Sacrifice.spirit_zh: 你已勝利。因為你終於記得怎麼臣服。
Right Arm: Sacrifice.spirit_en: You have won. Because you finally remembered how to surrender.

Left Leg: Still.dancer: 我左腳扎根，成為山的另一條根
Left Leg: Still.spirit_zh: 根已深入。我和你一起支撐這片土地。
Left Leg: Still.spirit_en: The root has gone deep. I hold this land with you.

Left Leg: Sway.spirit_zh: 風帶來了消息：你終於回家了。
Left Leg: Sway.spirit_en: The wind carries news: you have finally come home.

Left Leg: Stamp.dancer: 我重重踏地，敲醒沉睡的大地
Left Leg: Stamp.spirit_zh: 鼓聲我聽見了。我帶來所有沉睡的祖靈，一起看你跳舞。
Left Leg: Stamp.spirit_en: I heard the drum. I brought every sleeping ancestor to watch you dance.

Left Leg: Fling.dancer: 我踢向天空，向暴風挑釁
Left Leg: Fling.spirit_zh: 暴風退縮了。它說：你比我還狂野。
Left Leg: Fling.spirit_en: The storm stepped back. It says: You are wilder than me.

Left Leg: Circle.dancer: 我用左腳劃出世界的邊界
Left Leg: Circle.spirit_zh: 界已定。邪靈永遠跨不過你畫的那條線。
Left Leg: Circle.spirit_en: The boundary is set. Evil can never cross the line you drew.

Left Leg: Sacrifice.dancer: 我左膝跪地，向看不見的一切臣服
Left Leg: Sacrifice.spirit_zh: 我看見了。你的膝蓋碰地的那一刻，整個部落都站起來了。
Left Leg: Sacrifice.spirit_en: I saw it. The moment your knee touched the ground, the entire tribe stood taller.

Right Leg: Still.dancer: 我右腳站穩，承載歸鄉的重量
Right Leg: Still.spirit_zh: 你已經到家了。不用再走了。
Right Leg: Still.spirit_en: You are home. You no longer need to walk.

Right Leg: Sway.dancer: 我右腿隨潮汐起伏，回應月亮的呼喚
Right Leg: Sway.spirit_zh: 月亮說：歡迎回來，我的孩子。
Right Leg: Sway.spirit_en: The moon says: Welcome home, my child.

Right Leg: Stamp.spirit_zh: 每踏一次，我就答應你一個願望。現在你已經有三個了。
Right Leg: Stamp.spirit_en: One stomp, one wish granted. You now have three.

Right Leg: Fling.spirit_zh: 千年已過。你終於跨過來了。我在這邊等你很久了。
Right Leg: Fling.spirit_en: A thousand years have passed. You finally stepped across. I have been waiting.

Right Leg: Circle.dancer: 我用右腳完成最後一筆，圓滿了
Right Leg: Circle.spirit_zh: 圈已閉合。你出不去，我也進不來──我們只能一起跳下去。
Right Leg: Circle.spirit_en: The circle is closed. You cannot leave. I cannot enter. We can only dance together forever.

Right Leg: Sacrifice.dancer: 我右膝跪地，血脈化為誓言
Right Leg: Sacrifice.spirit_zh: 誓言我聽見了。從今以後，你的血就是我們的血。
Right Leg: Sacrifice.spirit_en: I heard your oath. From now on, your blood is our blood.

Waist: Still.dancer: 我腰身靜止，天地軸心對齊
Waist: Still.spirit_zh: 軸心已正。你現在就是世界的中心。
Waist: Still.spirit_en: The axis is aligned. You are now the center of the world.

Waist: Sway.dancer: 我腰如山脈呼吸，緩慢而深沉
Waist: Sway.spirit_zh: 山脈說：你終於學會我們的呼吸節奏了。
Waist: Sway.spirit_en: The mountains say: You have finally learned our rhythm.

Waist: Stamp.dancer: 我扭轉腰身，風暴由此誕生
Waist: Stamp.spirit_zh: 風暴已生。但它聽你的話。
Waist: Stamp.spirit_en: The storm is born. But it obeys you.

Waist: Fling.dancer: 我旋轉核心，銀河為之回應
Waist: Fling.spirit_zh: 銀河轉動了。它說：終於有人記得怎麼啟動我。
Waist: Fling.spirit_en: The galaxy spins. It says: Finally, someone remembers how to start me.

Waist: Circle.dancer: 我把整個地平線畫進我的身體
Waist: Circle.spirit_zh: 圓已畫完。從此刻起，所有方向都以你為中心。
Waist: Circle.spirit_en: The circle is complete. From this moment, all directions begin with you.

Waist: Sacrifice.dancer: 我獻出我的中心，成為祭儀本身
Waist: Sacrifice.spirit_zh: 中心已空。我填進去了。現在你是活的祭壇，我們在你裡面跳舞。
Waist: Sacrifice.spirit_en: The center is empty. I have filled it. You are now the living altar. We dance inside you.
